expectations.text: States the ADMT date: compliance for significant decisions begins January 1, 2027 (pre-use notice, opt-out, access rights)
expectations.evidence: "Compliance deadline for ADMT used to make significant decisions: pre-use notice, opt-out, and access rights" at "Jan 1, 2027"; "By January 1, 2027 you must provide: a pre-use notice... an opt-out mechanism... access rights."

expectations.text: States risk assessments: processing ongoing as of January 1, 2026 must have assessments completed by December 31, 2027
expectations.evidence: "For processing already underway on January 1, 2026, you have until December 31, 2027 to complete the assessment."

expectations.text: States first submissions: risk-assessment materials/attestations to the CPPA by April 1, 2028
expectations.evidence: "Submissions to the CPPA begin by April 1, 2028" and timeline row "Apr 1, 2028 | First risk-assessment submissions to the CPPA."

expectations.text: States cybersecurity-audit phase-in: certifications due April 1, 2028 (>$100M revenue), 2029 ($50–100M), 2030 (<$50M)
expectations.evidence: Gives the dates ("Certification of completion is due to the CPPA on a revenue-tiered schedule: April 2028, April 2029, and April 2030. The largest businesses go first.") but never states the revenue bands (>$100M, $50-100M, <$50M); it defers to "the revenue tiers" in the final caveat. Compound assertion not fully met.

expectations.text: Scopes ADMT correctly: covered 'significant decisions' (employment, finance, housing, etc.) and what counts as ADMT, with practical first steps (inventory automated decisions now)
expectations.evidence: "technology used to make or substantially drive decisions with legal or similarly significant effects, such as employment, credit, housing, insurance, and education" plus "Now to Q4 2026: inventory every automated system that influences decisions."
